long_biography.plain_text:
Entertainment entrepreneur David Geffen has concentrated much of his public activity on philanthropy since retiring from the industry. At Yale, an endowment bearing his name made professional drama education tuition-free in perpetuity, changing the financial model for every degree and certificate student admitted to the school.

His giving has also supported medical education and research at UCLA, museums and performing-arts institutions. At the Los Angeles County Museum of Art, it helped fund a new building for the permanent collection. The museum inaugurated it as the David Geffen Galleries, creating a lasting public setting for art.
